I’d like to get a regular SotM game night together in the St Louis, MO area. Anybody else interested?
What night of the week is best – or would a weekend afternoon be better?
Would the group be interested in a weekly game, every other week, or monthly? (I can’t make it to a weekly game myself, but I’m not the only player – I HOPE!)
Where would we play? A local gaming store would be ideal for me (I like Newcastle Comics in Maryland Heights), but we’d have to coordinate it with the store of course. Or would someone like to host it in their house?
